items.name: Clock
items.description: Clock resource provided by a mudpit burbler mine.

items.name: Patch cable
items.description: Joins two jacks on a rack. Racks come with the spare cables their voice needs; these are for patches of your own.

items.name: Square wave
items.description: A square-wave primitive mined from a lightning bug, like coal in a factory builder. Use it in modular-synthesis recipes as a VCO waveform, LFO, or gate.
